notes.means: Complete means require both prespecified videos. Partial means are separate and retain n/2.
notes.events: Mean absolute midpoint offset over every frozen event within each video, then equal video weights.
notes.reference_mf: Method MF minus that task's reference-self MF, paired before averaging.
notes.sampling: Actual recorded sampling time, equally weighted per video. Shared hardware, different hosts and historical capture scopes are not controlled; no speed benefit is inferred.
notes.awq: Not combined; nine official metrics only.
